title: GRaSP: Latency-Aware Optimization for Geo-Distributed Retrieval-Augmented Generation
abstract: arXiv:2610.26938v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) is increasingly served across geo-distributed cloud and edge infrastructures, where wide-area latency, cross-region egress cost, and data-residency rules compete with retrieval quality. Conventional pipelines rank by semantic similarity alone and ignore where content lives, inflating tail latency and cost. We formalize the Geo-RAG Selection Problem (GRaSP), a drop-in re-scoring layer that decays relevance by latency and adds an optional cost penalty under a cardinality budget and per-region caps, with no retraining. We first settle its complexity: the base formulation is a linear objective over a partition matroid, solved optimally by an O(N log N) greedy algorithm, rather than NP-hard as a knapsack framing suggests, with hardness entering only under an additive egress budget. translated_title: GRaSP：面向地理分布式检索增强生成的延迟感知优化
translated_abstract: 检索增强生成（RAG）日益被部署在地理分布式的云和边缘基础设施上，在这些环境中，广域网延迟、跨区域出口流量成本以及数据驻留规则与检索质量相互制约。传统流水线仅依据语义相似度进行排序，而忽略了内容所在的地理位置，从而推高了尾延迟和成本。我们将地理RAG选择问题形式化为GRaSP，这是一个即插即用的重评分层，通过延迟对相关性进行衰减，并在基数预算和各区域上限约束下添加可选的成本惩罚，且无需重新训练。我们首先确定了该问题的计算复杂度：基础形式化是划分拟阵上的线性目标函数，可以通过O(N log N)的贪心算法最优求解，而非像背包问题框架所暗示的那样是NP难问题；只有在一附加出口预算约束下问题才会变难。在模拟四区域广域网的五节点CloudLab测试床上，基于Natural Questions语料库（268万个段落）的实验中，GRaSP的收益……
tldr: 该论文提出GRaSP，一种面向地理分布式检索增强生成的延迟感知重评分方法，通过将问题形式化为划分拟阵上的线性目标并用O(N log N)贪心算法最优求解，在无需重训练的情况下兼顾检索相关性、延迟与成本。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes GRaSP, a latency-aware re-scoring approach for geo-distributed Retrieval-Augmented Generation, which formulates the problem as a linear objective over a partition matroid solved optimally by an O(N log N) greedy algorithm, balancing retrieval relevance, latency, and cost without retraining.
